newsitem.title: KENYA: Tea prices firmer at Kenyan auction.
newsitem.headline: Tea prices firmer at Kenyan auction.

text.p: Improved and strong demand at the weekly Kenyan tea export auction on Monday led to firmer prices, traders said.
Coloury mediums were fully firm to five U.S. cents up while lower mediums and plainer descriptions were firm to up three.
Brighter PF1's gained 3-5 cents while best P Dusts rose by up to two cents. Brighter Dust 1s were 3-6 cents dearer.
Fannings and Dusts were fully firm to often dearer.
There was strong enquiry from Britain, Egypt and Sudan. Other Middle East countries were active and there were some line orders for South Africa.
